metadata.description: Emails the dev team when Origination stops getting data: CTRM GraphQL failing, the ODS or Origination SQL database failing, or the nightly CustomerSync aborting. Log search alerts on the environment's App Insights. See infra/alerts/README.md.
Shown in the alert name and email subject, so the team can tell which environment fired.
Value for the Environment tag (matches the Logic App templates: QA, Prod).
The environment's App Insights component, in this resource group (appi-origination-<env>-eus).
Appended to resource names, e.g. origination-qa-eus.
The dev team: who gets the alert and the all-clear emails.
Log search alert rules must sit in the same region as the App Insights they query.

variables.ctrmQuery:
let calls = toscalar(dependencies | where name == 'POST /internal/graphql' | summarize sum(itemCount));
traces
| where message startswith 'CTRM read failed'
| parse message with * '[Infrastructure]: ' status ' (HTTP ' http ', code ' gqlCode ', CTRM correlationId' *
// Whose side: CTRM answered with an error or timed out (HC0045) = theirs; we could not sign in, were refused, or
// sent a query CTRM rejected = ours; could not reach the gateway at all = cannot tell.
| extend side = case(
    status in ('TokenFailure', 'Unauthorized'), 'ours',
    status == 'QueryError' and gqlCode !in ('(none)', 'HC0045'), 'ours',
    status == 'EgressBlocked', 'unreachable',
    'ctrm')
| summarize failedReads = sum(itemCount), ctrmSide = sumif(itemCount, side == 'ctrm'), ourSide = sumif(itemCount, side == 'ours')
| extend ctrmCalls = coalesce(calls, 0)
| extend failedPct = round(100.0 * failedReads / max_of(ctrmCalls, failedReads, 1), 0)
| where failedReads >= 5 and failedPct >= 10
| extend likelySide = case(
    ctrmSide >= 0.8 * failedReads, 'CTRM side (gateway or DB2)',
    ourSide >= 0.8 * failedReads, 'Our side (sign-in, permissions or our query)',
    'Cannot tell (gateway unreachable, or a mix)')
| project failedReads, likelySide
variables.databaseQuery:
union exceptions, traces
| extend code = tostring(customDimensions.ErrorCode)
| where code endswith 'DB_UNAVAILABLE' or code in ('INFRASTRUCTURE_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', 'ENTITLEMENTS_UNAVAILABLE')
    or type has 'SqlException' or innermostType has 'SqlException'
| summarize failedRequests = dcount(operation_Id)
| where failedRequests >= 3
variables.customerSyncQuery:
union traces, exceptions
| where severityLevel >= 3
| extend text = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.FormattedMessage), message, outerMessage)
| where text has 'CustomerSync' and (text has 'aborted' or text has 'cycle failed')
| project timestamp, text

properties.description: At least 5 CTRM reads failed and at least 10% of CTRM GraphQL calls failed in the last 30 minutes, so contracts, tickets, pricing or customers are not loading. The likelySide value in this email says whose side it is: 'CTRM side' = the gateway or DB2 answered with an error or timed out, so tell the CTRM API team; 'Our side' = our sign-in, permissions or query; 'Cannot tell' = the gateway could not be reached. infra/alerts/README.md has the one-call probe and who to contact. A second email arrives when it clears.

At least 3 requests or jobs hit a SQL failure in the last 15 minutes: the ODS views, the Origination app database (customers, contracts, tickets, notes) or the TradeUnitPreferences database (who may see which trade units) are timing out, refusing connections, or missing a view or column. Check App Insights exceptions of type SqlException and the ErrorCode on the InfrastructureException. A second email arrives when it clears.

The customer sync aborted or failed, so nothing was written and the producer list stays as it was until the next good run (07:00 UTC daily, and 60 seconds after every app start). Aborts from the mass-deactivation guard are on purpose; follow docs/operations/OUTAGE-RECOVERY-PLAYBOOK.md. This alert does not auto-resolve: close it once a run succeeds.
